# Outpatient procedure rooms

!!! info "Definition"
    An outpatient procedure room is a clinical room where minor diagnostic or therapeutic procedures are performed on patients who do not require hospital admission.

## Activity classification

Activity is limited to face-to-face outpatient attendances classified in the procedure group.

## Calculating capacity

#### Pathway: deriving workload

Calculate the effective procedure time by adding an allowance for time lost to appointments where patients do not attend (DNA).

!!! quote ""

    $$
    \begin{aligned}
    \text{Effective procedure time (minutes)}
    &= \text{Procedure time (minutes)} \\
    &\quad + \left(
    \frac{\text{DNA rate}}{1-\text{DNA rate}}
    \times \text{DNA time (minutes)}
    \right)
    \end{aligned}
    $$

Multiply attended procedure appointments by the effective procedure time, then convert minutes into hours.

!!! quote ""

    $$
    \text{Procedure hours}
    =
    \frac{\text{Attendances} \times \text{Effective procedure time (minutes)}}{60}
    $$

#### Operating model: converting workload to capacity

Calculate the required number of outpatient procedure rooms by dividing procedure hours by the product of the service's annual operational hours and the assumed utilisation rate.

!!! quote ""

    $$
    \text{Required outpatient procedure rooms}
    =
    \frac{\text{Procedure hours}}
    {\text{Annual operational hours} \times \text{Utilisation rate}}
    $$

## Assumptions

Assumptions may apply to an individual subgroup, several subgroups or all groups.

| Subgroup | Assumption | Type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| All groups | Procedure time | Pathway |
| All groups | Did not attend rate | Pathway |
| All groups | Did not attend time | Pathway |
| All groups | Utilisation rate | Operational |
| All groups | Annual operational hours | Operational |


## Notes

* Procedure durations are represented using a single average because procedure-level details are not currently available.

??? info "Technical details"
    **Capacity outputs**

    * `OP_PROC_ROOMS`

    **Conversion archetype:** appointment-slot utilisation · `FRM_APPOINTMENT_UTIL`

    **Operational constraint:** available appointment time, adjusted for utilisation

    **Workload object:** `procedure_hours`

    **Classification expressions**

    | Subgroup | Expression |
    | --- | --- |
    | All groups | (`CLASS_OP_ATTEND` AND `CLASS_OP_FACE_TO_FACE` AND `CLASS_OP_GROUP_PROCEDURE`) |

    **Classification definitions**

    | ID | Definition | Rule |
    | --- | --- | --- |
    | `CLASS_OP_ATTEND` | Outpatient activity within the Demand Model scope | atentype IN (1, 2, 21, 22) AND sex IN (1, 2) AND age BETWEEN 0 AND 90 |
    | `CLASS_OP_FACE_TO_FACE` | Face-to-face outpatient activity | attendance = 1 |
    | `CLASS_OP_GROUP_PROCEDURE` | Outpatient activity assigned to the procedure group | group = "procedure" |

    **Classification notes**

    * `CLASS_OP_ATTEND`: Age bounds are inclusive.
    * `CLASS_OP_FACE_TO_FACE`: attendance is calculated as 1 - is_tele_appointment. Within the outpatient scope, atentype 1 or 2 gives attendance = 1.
    * `CLASS_OP_GROUP_PROCEDURE`: Assigned when has_procedures is true: the appointment is face-to-face and sushrg is non-null and does not start with U or WF. Procedure grouping takes precedence over first or follow-up grouping.

    **Assumption references**

    | Subgroup | Assumption ID |
    | --- | --- |
    | All groups | `OP_PROC_TIME` |
    | All groups | `OP_PROC_DNA_RATE` |
    | All groups | `OP_PROC_DNA_TIME` |
    | All groups | `OP_PROC_UTIL` |
    | All groups | `OP_PROC_ANNUAL_OPERATIONAL_HOURS` |
